tasks.title: Project documentation hub
tasks.notes: Completed 2026-10-09. All 12 documentation routes render. Browser search returns relevant token documentation. Setup, architecture, token contract, plugin guide, component workflow, decisions, and validation boundaries are documented. Production build and TypeScript checks pass.

tasks.title: Task manager and completion rules
tasks.notes: Completed 2026-10-09. Automated tests cover every pair of component statuses, duplicate prevention, atomic persistence, stale revisions, and reopening. Browser checks verified both-track completion, duplicate rejection, documentation-task creation, reload persistence, filtering, and the mobile dialog at 390px. Changes persist in data/tasks.json. Local single-server scope.

tasks.title: Custom Figma token sync plugin
tasks.notes: Initial local-file importer. Complete a real Figma create/update/alias/modes/re-run/binding test before Done. Code build alone is insufficient.

tasks.title: Token validation and CSS generation
tasks.notes: Completed for the initial schema on 2026-10-09. Generated deterministic CSS preserving aliases and mode selectors. Tests reject cycles, missing targets, missing modes, invalid values, and CSS-name collisions. Sample tokens are an isolated fixture. Production-token migration and DTCG normalization remain separate tasks.

tasks.title: Audit the full Figma component inventory
tasks.notes: Read the current library, reconcile one canonical task per component, and record current evidence. Do not infer completion from historical snapshots.

tasks.title: Set up the Lit component package
tasks.notes: Create a typed package with exports and token consumption. Verify one real component in a consumer.

tasks.title: Set up the Lit Storybook playground
tasks.notes: Use Web Components + Vite. Verify a real Lit story, editable controls, themes, and a docs link.

tasks.title: Write component usage documentation
tasks.notes: Add API, slot, state, accessibility, and Storybook references as components become available.

tasks.title: Add repository transport to the plugin
tasks.notes: Choose explicit repository access and authentication. Preserve preview/apply and local-file fallback. Do not embed credentials in the bundle.

tasks.title: Add DTCG normalization
tasks.notes: Define and verify conversions for aliases, collection modes, units, typography, and effects. Current schema is project-specific.

tasks.title: Migrate real library tokens into code
tasks.notes: Audit existing collections and aliases, establish stable key-to-variable mappings, test a copy of the library, and preserve consumer bindings.

tasks.title: Document plugin migration strategy
tasks.notes: Document how to adopt existing Figma variables, retain stable IDs, handle collection and mode renames, and recover from partial imports before migrating the real library.
